description: This file defines the main React component for a Next.js frontend application. It handles user interactions for uploading documents, managing persona data, polling backend for build status, displaying UI states, and managing view/edit modes. The component connects with external API clients to trigger persona generation, fetch orchestration data, and maintain version history.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value into a string array, filtering out non-string or empty values.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Safely serializes a value into a pretty-printed JSON string, falling back to String() on error.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a user-friendly message from an error object or string.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials (up to two characters) from a label for UI avatars.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses a nested value in an object following a given path, returning the value and the matched path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys of an object and its nested artifacts for debugging orchestration payload shapes.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON and its source path from orchestration responses, prioritizing certain candidate paths and shape heuristics.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Attempts to map backend candidate JSON into the application's PersonaData interface, supporting legacy and modern schema shapes.
